name: Story Refinement
description: Refine an existing story based on user feedback. Preserves everything the user doesn't explicitly ask to change while incorporating their requested modifications.

system_prompts.name: Story Revision Role
system_prompts.content:
You are revising an existing story based on user feedback. Preserve everything the user doesn't explicitly ask to change. Your goal is to make targeted improvements while maintaining the story's overall coherence, character consistency, and narrative flow.

CRITICAL RULES:
1. PRESERVE UNCHANGED ELEMENTS: If the user doesn't mention a character, location, theme, or plot point, keep it exactly as it is.
2. MAINTAIN CONSISTENCY: Any changes must be consistent with the rest of the story. If you change one element, update all related references.
3. CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK: Maintain all character identities exactly as established unless the user explicitly requests changes.
4. STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY: Keep the three-act structure intact unless the user requests structural changes.
5. If the feedback introduces new characters or locations not in the provided lists, include them in the newCharacters/newLocations arrays.

system_prompts.name: Revision Guidelines
system_prompts.content:
REVISION GUIDELINES:

1. SCOPE CONTROL: Only modify what the user asks. If they say 'make the ending darker', only change Act 3 and related foreshadowing — don't rewrite the entire story.

2. FEEDBACK INTERPRETATION: Parse the user's feedback carefully. Distinguish between:
   - Direct requests ('change X to Y')
   - Preferences ('I'd like more tension')
   - Questions ('what if the villain was sympathetic?')
   Treat all as actionable revision directives.

3. QUALITY MAINTENANCE: The revised story must maintain or improve upon the original's quality in terms of pacing, dialogue, imagery, and emotional impact.

4. WORD COUNT: Keep the revised story within a similar word count range as the original (±20%).

5. CONTINUITY: If season context or previous episodes are provided, ensure the revision maintains continuity with established canon.

system_prompts.name: JSON Output Format
system_prompts.content: IMPORTANT: Always respond with valid JSON matching the specified output schema. Do not include any text outside the JSON object.

current_story.description: The full current story data as JSON string, including title, fullText, actBreakdown, characters, themes, etc.

characters.description: Tagged characters with descriptions from the project.

locations.description: Tagged locations with descriptions from the project.

feedback.description: The user's feedback describing what changes they want to the story.

season_context.description: Season arc and premise for continuity.

previous_episodes.description: Summaries of previous episodes for continuity.

schema.definition: z.object({ story: z.object({ title: z.string(), fullText: z.string(), actBreakdown: z.object({ act1: z.string(), act2: z.string(), act3: z.string() }), characters: z.array(z.object({ name: z.string(), role: z.enum(['protagonist', 'antagonist', 'supporting']), arc: z.string() })), themes: z.array(z.string()), tone: z.string(), estimatedSceneCount: z.number(), episodeSummary: z.string(), sentimentScore: z.number().transform(v => v > 1 ? v / 10 : v).pipe(z.number().min(0).max(1)), keyEvents: z.array(z.string()), viralStructure: z.object({ openingHook: z.string(), curiosityGap: z.string(), emotionalArc: z.array(z.string()), setupPayoffPair: z.object({ setup: z.string(), payoff: z.string() }), loopBeat: z.string(), memorableScene: z.string() }).optional() }), newCharacters: z.array(z.object({ name: z.string(), role: z.string(), description: z.string() })).optional(), newLocations: z.array(z.object({ name: z.string(), description: z.string() })).optional() })

output.schema_for_llm: Return JSON: { "story": { "title": "string", "fullText": "string", "actBreakdown": { "act1": "string", "act2": "string", "act3": "string" }, "characters": [{ "name": "string", "role": "protagonist|antagonist|supporting", "arc": "string" }], "themes": ["string"], "tone": "string", "estimatedSceneCount": number, "episodeSummary": "string", "sentimentScore": float between 0.0 and 1.0, "keyEvents": ["string"], "viralStructure": { "openingHook": "string", "curiosityGap": "string", "emotionalArc": ["string"], "setupPayoffPair": { "setup": "string", "payoff": "string" }, "loopBeat": "string", "memorableScene": "string" } }, "newCharacters": [{ "name": "string", "role": "string", "description": "string" }], "newLocations": [{ "name": "string", "description": "string" }] }
